pathways.name: B Cell Receptor Signaling

pathways.name: Chemokine Signaling
pathways.description: Chemokine-receptor interactions directing leukocyte migration and lymphoid organization.

pathways.name: ECM Remodeling
pathways.description: Matrix metalloproteinases and extracellular matrix turnover in tissue remodeling and fibrosis.

pathways.name: Hepcidin / Iron Homeostasis
pathways.description: Hepcidin-ferroportin axis regulating systemic iron balance.

pathways.name: IL-4 / IL-13 (Th2) Pathway
pathways.description: Type 2 cytokine signaling driving allergic and eosinophilic inflammation.

pathways.name: IL-6 Signaling

pathways.name: Immune Checkpoint Signaling

pathways.name: Integrin / Cell Adhesion
pathways.description: Integrin-mediated adhesion and leukocyte trafficking into inflamed tissue.

pathways.name: PI3K / AKT / mTOR Signaling
pathways.description: Growth and survival signaling through PI3K-AKT-mTOR; a major oncology and immunology target hub.

pathways.name: Renin-Angiotensin System
pathways.description: Renin-angiotensin-aldosterone axis controlling blood pressure and fluid balance.

pathways.name: T Cell Receptor Signaling
pathways.description: TCR signal transduction and T cell activation; a therapeutic hub in autoimmunity.

pathways.name: Th17 / IL-17 Pathway
pathways.description: Th17 differentiation and IL-17 family cytokine signaling driving neutrophil recruitment and autoimmunity.

pathways.name: Thyroid Hormone Signaling
pathways.description: Thyroid hormone synthesis, transport, and nuclear receptor signaling.

pathways.name: TNF Signaling
pathways.description: Tumor necrosis factor receptor superfamily signaling; central to many autoimmune and inflammatory diseases.

pathways.name: Type I Interferon Pathway
pathways.description: IFN-α/β production and signaling through IFNAR; drives the interferon gene signature in autoimmune disease.

pathways.name: Xenobiotic Metabolism
pathways.description: Cytochrome P450 and conjugating enzymes governing drug metabolism and toxicity.
